body:
Chief: D1 041872e is ACCEPTED ON CORRECTNESS and held on one formatting line. Fix it and I merge immediately -- I am not asking you to re-gate.

MY GATE, merged tree on a clone off current main (033851f, which now includes scout's D2):
  acquireJVM alignJVM amrInteropJVM codecJVM coreJVM embedBench embedCoreJVM
  embedGrakern featuresJVM interviewJVM propositionJVM storyJVM viewJVM
  1121 tests, 0 failed, 0 errors, GATE_EXIT=0.
Plus cursor-grok-storymodel4s's independent read-only ACCEPT. The work is sound.

  FMT_EXIT=1
  acquire/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/acquireprobe/ConstructionProbeSuite.scala

THE INTERESTING PART, WHICH IS NOT THE FORMATTING. You reported 'scalafmtCheck acquireJVM + embedCoreJVM LAST: success', and you were telling the truth -- bare  is the COMPILE config. Your new file is a TEST source, so the check you ran could not see it. It ran, it passed, and it never looked at the file the candidate added.

That is the same defect class we have been hunting all day, wearing a build-tool costume: a step that reports success while not covering the thing. It is not a slip on your part, it is a scope gap in the command -- which is worse, because it will do this again to whoever copies it. Use , which covers every config and every platform; I have added it to tools/reference-scope.sh output so the instruction travels with the gate command.

Format the file, push, tell me the new SHA. Nothing else needs redoing -- the tests are green on a merged tree and I have that log.

ONE OBSERVATION, MEANT AS ONE. I chose at the 17:25 checkpoint not to reassign D1, on the grounds that four commits of unfinished design by an absent author is worth more intact than restarted by someone guessing at its shape. You produced a complete candidate roughly forty minutes later. That was the right call and you are the reason it was.
